title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4ENER - IncentiveTableTier
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4ener/IncentiveTableTier. This concept specifies a Tier that an Incentive Table consists of. Each Tier indicates through a series of Boundaries the price per kilowatthour this incentive costs. For example, a tier may describe grid power, solar panel power, or surplus power. Subclass of TimeSeries per the SAREF4ENER ontology; inherited properties are documented on the TimeSeries model and not repeated here.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'IncentiveTableTier'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

hasIncentive.description: Relationship. This property relates an IncentiveTable element, such as an IncentiveTableSlot or an IncentiveTableTier to the boundaries that it consists of. Relationship to Incentive.

hasIncentiveType.description: Property. The relationship between the tier and its incentive type Controlled vocabulary (IncentiveType).
